Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: kkwills13
Message:
fix: address security review findings

- Switch filepath.Match to path.Match for platform-independent glob
  matching (env var names are not filesystem paths)
- Rename blocked → blockedNames in wrap.go to make the names-only
  contract self-documenting and prevent accidental value leaks
- Add TestBlockedNamesNeverContainValues regression test asserting
  no secret values ever appear in the blocked names list
